decision_contract: Seven evidence cases evaluate entailment or contradiction within named supplied excerpts; the one world case retains an unknown world claim. false requires explicit contradiction. unverifiable includes unresolved evidence; it never means false.
origin_contract: origins lists acceptable alternative corpus-relative documentary source versions for the supported assertion, not the historical first publication on the internet. No origin is labeled for an AI-authored false mutation or unsupported claim.
edges_contract: edges are observed cites relations visible in the supplied excerpts. They are exhaustive only within these excerpts where edges_evaluable=true, not an internet-wide graph. A verified source edge may be evaluated even if the mutated target has no published origin.

limitations: Eight purposively selected events, not a representative sample or held-out benchmark.
All labels were initially authored by AI and require human review; another AI review is not independent human labeling.
No original false news story was fabricated or attributed to a real publisher; false claims are explicitly authored counterfactual probes.
Excerpts may omit context. A source document is not equivalent to proof of world truth.
No live retrieval benchmark, historical capture authentication, or model API evaluation is performed by this dataset.
